svg.title: How the law gets in
svg.desc: Animated diagram of the one-time build. Two official PDFs, the DPDP Act 2023 (44 sections, 9 chapters) and the DPDP Rules 2025 (23 rules, 7 schedules), go into a rule-based chunker that splits them at every Section, Rule and Schedule. The result is 81 chunks: 49 from the Act and 32 from the Rules. Each chunk is embedded by meaning with OpenAI and by exact terms with BM25, then stored in Qdrant Cloud.
svg.text: Done once at build time, and again whenever the law is amended.
Input: the two official Gazette PDFs, the DPDP Act 2023 and the final DPDP Rules 2025.
A rule-based chunker splits them at every Section, Rule and Schedule. Tables stay whole.
Result: 81 chunks, each carrying its citation, PDF page number and in-force date.
Each chunk is indexed twice: by meaning (OpenAI embeddings) and by exact terms (BM25).
Everything lands in Qdrant Cloud. The live app never needs the build machine again.
Re-run these steps whenever the law is amended.
PDFs → chunker → 81 chunks → embeddings → Qdrant Cloud
